§C.8 Ground Truth — Lists and Forms

What to do, when producing ground truth, in the cases the list and form rules leave to review. Each step serves the rule it links to; the rule decides the output.

Situation Step Rule
A form and a real ruled grid cannot be cleanly separated — they share rulings, or the fields sit inside the grid's own borders Reject the page rather than guess a boundary between form and table Forms and Key-Value Regions§10.1, Ignoring and Rejecting§5.6
A page prints buttons (Print, Save, Clear), an input placeholder, or a box reserved for a stamp or seal Apply the working default and record the page, so it can be revisited when the open point closes Printed Buttons and Placeholders§10.4.6
A checklist item prints its box before its id Write the box first, per the working default, and record the page Checklists§10.4.3
A box's state cannot be read with confidence, even zoomed in Enter [ ], as the rule requires; do not guess a tick from the text layer Checkboxes§10.4.2
